QuestInfo.name: Finding the Instructor
QuestInfo.0: #b#p511##k in #b#m10004000##k wants to test whether I'm worthy of receiving his teachings.
QuestInfo.1: #m10004000#'s #b#p511# gave me a letter to deliver to the #b#p514##k, who I should be able to find somewhere in #b#m10004023##k. He said I'd learn the rest of the details there.
QuestInfo.2: In #b#m10004023##k, I met #b#p514##k. He said he would test whether I was worthy of making the 2nd job advancement. Great! I told him I was ready for anything!

0.0: Impressive... So, what do you think? Do you want to get even stronger than you are right now? Pass a simple test, and I'll help you do just that! Wanna do it?

yes.0: Good thinking. You look strong, don't get me wrong, but there's still a need to test your strength and see if you're the real deal. The test isn't too difficult, so you'll do just fine... Here, take this letter first. Make sure you don't lose it.
yes.1: Please get this letter to the #b#p514##k, who may be around #b#m10004023##k, near Perion. He's taking my place as instructor, as I am busy here.
yes.2: Get him the letter, and he'll give you the test in my stead. For more details, hear it straight from him. Best of luck to you.

no.0: Really? It will help you out a great deal on your journey if you can get stronger quickly... If you change your mind in the future, please feel free to come back. Know that I'll make you much more powerful than you are right now.

1.0: Hmmm... This is definitely a letter from #b#p511##k. So, you came all the way here to take the test and make the 2nd job advancement as a Warrior?
